feature: confidence-rated battlefield scenarios, team objectives, role bids, assignments, reservations and planning-trace@3

implemented.beliefState: Actor-visible evidence records scope, confidence, provenance, revision, age, expiry, scenario relationships and numeric hysteresis thresholds.
implemented.scenarios: Compatible actor and team scenarios remain active together with entry/exit thresholds and continuity.
implemented.coordination: The team board records frontline geometry, formation components, role bids, winning assignments, lane reservations and target effect budgets.
implemented.grounding: Existing behavior plans are methods under assignments; legality and emergency directives remain authoritative.
implemented.rangePolicy: A penalized ranged attack with a reachable better range is marked compromised, compared with setup movement, and capped below that closing option.
implemented.trace: planning-trace@3 records doctrine, evidence, scenarios, team objective, actor assignment and bids, legality, methods, timing, bounded primitives, choice and outcome.
implemented.privacy: Foundry coordination receives known Hidden squares but never live Undetected coordinates.

installation.clientAction: Reload every connected Foundry client with Ctrl+F5.
